title: UPSC CAPF AC Answer Key 2026 – Out
postName: Central Armed Police Forces (Assistant Commandants) Examination 2026
vacancyDetails: About 349 Assistant Commandant posts; provisional Paper-I answer key (GA & Intelligence) set-wise
qualification: Bachelor’s Degree from a recognized University
ageLimit: 20 to 25 years (as on crucial date; relaxations as per UPSC CAPF rules)
selectionProcess: Written (Paper-I & II) → Physical Standards/Efficiency → Interview / Personality Test → Medical
documentsRequired: Admit card, registration credentials for login, photo ID for record
howToApply:
1. Visit https://www.upsc.gov.in
2. Open Provisional Answer Key CAPF (AC) Exam 2026
3. Download set-wise Paper-I PDF (A/B/C/D)
4. Calculate score (2 marks correct, −1/3 wrong for Paper-I typically)
5. Raise objections within UPSC window if enabled
shortDescription: UPSC CAPF AC Answer Key 2026 released on 22 July for exam on 19 July 2026. Paper-I provisional key at upsc.gov.in.
content:
UPSC has released the provisional answer key for CAPF (Assistant Commandants) Examination 2026 on 22 July 2026.

Written exam: 19 July 2026. Paper-I (General Ability & Intelligence) key is available set-wise. Approx. vacancies: 349.

Download from upsc.gov.in. Final key is usually published with the result.
